question: What evidence shows that a small business backup can be restored after a failure?

documents.title: Pinned Backup Snapshot
documents.full_text: Every backup run records a content digest and completion timestamp. The immutable snapshot identity lets an operator select the exact archive during recovery.

documents.title: Restore Drill
documents.full_text: A quarterly drill restores files into an empty environment and compares their hashes with the recorded manifest. A copied archive is not accepted until the restored content matches.

documents.title: Independent Storage
documents.full_text: One encrypted copy remains outside the primary office and outside the production account. This separation preserves recovery material after a local or account-wide failure.

documents.title: Failed Recovery Evidence
documents.full_text: Restore errors and missing files stay in the audit record and trigger a named follow-up. Operators do not replace failed drill evidence with a later successful screenshot.

documents.title: Freezing Vegetable Soup
documents.full_text: Soup can be frozen in small containers after cooling. Leave space at the top because liquids expand in the freezer.

documents.title: Recovery After Exercise
documents.full_text: Gentle movement and sleep support recovery after a difficult training session. Training load should increase gradually.
